notes.title: UPDATE[12A]//Hotfix Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Greetings, Principals

We hope you’re enjoying the game! Have you assembled the perfect party to complete those challenging quests? Or are you still fine-tuning your strategy through trial and error? Regardless of where you stand, we’re thrilled to have you on board with us on this adventure and hope you find endless enjoyment in our game.

We understand some players have encountered issues when playing the game, but don’t worry! Our dedicated development team has been hard at work addressing these issues. We’re excited to bring you this latest update, which includes the following fixes:

- Remove unused Arcsilo blueprint as a research requirement.
- Fixed rare occurrence issues where students spawned in the wrong dungeon.
- Fixed behavior on some enemies.
- Fixed visual effects on some student skills that don’t work properly during battle.
- Fixed changes on settings that aren’t properly saved.
- Fixed alignment issues on party selection.
- Fixed issue where required student can be removed from the party and cause the game to crash.
- Fixed camera setting on exploration.
- Fixed achievements that players can’t complete.
- Fixed the HUD issue that sometimes doesn’t appear during battle.
- Fixed issues where players can’t complete quests.
- Fixed issues where students get stuck in some areas inside the dungeon.
- Fixed audio volume issue.
- Fixed the issue where the game crashes during exploration when the enemy chases the party.
- Fixed the issue where Rodno wasn’t removed from the academy after his graduation.
- Fixed issue in snowman minigame where the displayed button prompt is not correct.
- Fixed cinematic graduation bug where the principal is glitching.
- Fixed localization issues.
- Fixed issue when a battle with three monsters will make the player drop from the ground.
- Fixed some issues in fishing minigame.

That’s all for this update, Principals! If you find other issues, don't hesitate to report them. We are committed to delivering an even smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience. Thank you for being part of our community, and stay tuned for more exciting updates in the future!

notes.title: UPDATE[12]//Patch 0.13.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/d4d21f6b47be4775bc4f3c6444c7a10ef0a86b5d.jpg[/img]
Greetings, Principals! You should read about this update because it’s an important one. 

[b]We’re adding a new dungeon to the game[/b], and it’s not just any regular dungeon, Principals! 

To reach this location, you must go through a portal in the lava fields. However, the portal is locked until you complete a certain quest. Once you finish the quest, the portal to the dungeon will open, and its location will be marked on your map as the Sky Castle in the sky of Valthiria, the final dungeon of Valthiria Arc: Hero School Story 2. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/c3c74f079aa353cc13605894b866cb6525c23f8c.png[/img]

As the final dungeon of the game, this place will be filled with the strongest monsters in Valthiria you have ever encountered, and it’s also the battlefield for fighting the game’s final boss! Therefore, make the best preparations possible, Principals! Choose your students and teach them well because this is the battle that will determine the future of Valthiria!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/3ac8e6f1368c3f337438a5bcf1e01dce56aa060c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/1b363f00d7441abbbda4cade53dfd898efbe2833.png[/img]

[h2]This update includes: [/h2]

[list]
[*] New dungeon: Sky Castle 
[*] New quests
[*] Fixed bugs reported from player
[/list]

That’s all for this update, Principals! We’re getting closer to the official game release, and we, the VAHSS2 team, want to thank you very much for your tremendous support!

notes.title: Update [11]//Patch 0.12.0.0
notes.content:
We’ve got other students coming, Principals. And one of them is not even a human! 

Meet Zero Four and Kayla Palmer. Zero Four is a sentient arcstone-powered automaton built to replace heroes. Despite their slender physique, Zero Four can beat all monsters in Valthiria, even those who create trouble for professional heroes. However, without an official hero license, Zero Four can’t become a professional hero. To obtain the necessary license, they have come to your academy. 

The mastermind behind this remarkable creation is Kayla Palmer, a young inventor from Chernov. After her past tragedy, she has dedicated her life to designing machines capable of replacing heroes. She comes to your academy to witness Zero Four's triumph over fellow students and become the best hero Valthiria has ever seen. 

See their action in this video! 

[previewyoutube=bEnYkKT6cK0;full][/previewyoutube]

Being a hero involves more than just defeating monsters. So, can you help them understand that while they are attending the academy? 

Not only robots, but there will also be pets too! Yup, in this update, there will be pets that will spawn in the school grounds and those animals will change for every season. We hope their cuteness brings more fun to the academy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/18b5bae7b3d10408cb47dd12e27ad1c00a5ce621.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/925313a6fe009d30ad6fb75acbef55f582241dbf.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/36086712619370340ecaf1b49550e25717a660f6.png[/img]

That’s all for this update, Principals! See you in the next update!

notes.title: Update [10]/Patch 0.11.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/a2588dc924691964ff7891724f8f6b0d45ae6bbf.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Principals! We hope the new year is treating you well. We're excited to share some great news with you. Our game has received new updates! 

Tired of fighting the same monsters repeatedly? We've heard your requests and are introducing new opponents for you to fight. Be prepared to face Poult, Woodsman, and Strigger as they now roam Valthiria in the latest updates! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/47dc3f7ce20fb51af2656bde2e9cf0bd16d3f297.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/bf8c26d6495b7441d60cc72601b640afa396ed69.png[/img]

Get your students prepared for these monsters as they need different strategies to beat them. Or maybe you already have the perfect party formation in place? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/5dc7aff847a2059290fc9707f56c3126b506a967.png[/img]

Principals, your accomplishments should not go unrecognized. We are excited to announce the addition of achievements and trading cards to the game. Let's finish the game and collect them all! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/ed40db7d8b6f7483df954d518015f8182cc99aa0.png[/img]

We're also thrilled to announce the addition of multiple language support, allowing you to play the game in Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Indonesian, and Korean. As for Thai, French, German will come later!. 

To put it briefly, the updates include: 

[list]
[*] Added Steam Achievements  
[*] Added Steam Trading Cards  
[*] Revamped UI 
[*] Added Battle Log feature 
[*] Rebalanced Booster Shop and added seasonal discount feature 
[*] Added language support (Spanish, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Indonesian, and Korean) 
[*] Added new monsters: Poult, Clicker, Woodsman, and Strigger 
[*] New in-game cinematics
[/list] 

 
Thank you for your attention, Principals. We hope you enjoy the new features. We look forward to seeing you in the next updates!

notes.title: Update [9]//Patch 0.10.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/e2d57668bdec40106a95b422c84dd500683a1f51.jpg[/img]

It's the holiday season, Principals! We have one more update before we say goodbye to 2022. 

Sometimes, the best course of action is not to charge into battle but instead to take a step back and reevaluate the situation. Retreating does not mean you have lost; rather, it shows that you understand your own limitations and are willing to take the time to gain more strength. 

That is why we have added the “Escape” feature! With this feature, you can flee from the battle and rethink your strategy or return to learn more and level up your skills. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/e15fbea20ee6a563af07e47edebeb3d1229562d1.png[/img]

Apart from the “Escape” feature, we also made several improvements in the 0.10.0.0, including: 

[list]
[*] Revamped battle UI  
[*] Improved button prompts for the controller 
[*] New confirmation pop-ups on several screens  
[*] More new animations on the party selection screen  
[*] New graduation cinematic sequence 
[/list]

That’s all for this update, Principals! We are getting closer to the official game release, and all of us from the VAHSS2 team want to thank you very much for your support!  

Happy holidays and see you in the next update, Principals!

notes.title: Update [8]//Patch 0.9.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/3c49bee38e8fc34a065c655c7cd34cef20324469.png[/img]
Hello, Principals! We got some updates for you! 

A new champion has arrived in Valthiria! He’s a bard named Emerson Lake. 

Wait a minute, a bard? Why did he even go to a hero academy? Emerson wants to find an art treasure that has been lost for a long time, but one of the necessary conditions to find the treasure is that he needs to have the values of a hero. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/72a431c15bceab694080256a087f7054a6b4940b.png[/img]

He comes from a family of prosperous merchants who measure success solely by money, and his family sees his dedication to art as a waste. Can Emerson prove to his family that success is not only measured by material things? 

Curious to see Emerson in action? Check out this teaser video! 

[previewyoutube=0khkCid3SkE;full][/previewyoutube]

You can enjoy the adventure of Emerson and other champions with a gamepad. Yup, [b]VAHSS2 can now also be played with a gamepad controller![/b] Although it's still an early build, we ensure it won't disrupt your fun. But if you experience some inconveniences, make sure to let us know your issues. Don't worry; you can still choose to play the game using a keyboard and mouse as the default by going to settings. 

This update includes: 

[h2]Changelogs:[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Added controller support
[*] Revamped Building Mode UI
[*] Performance optimization
[*] Quest improvements
[*] Removed Dormitory and Arc Silo building cost and efficiency
[*] Added "Claim All" button to Achievements

[*] Art assets bugfix
[*] Fixed several tutorial texts
[*] Added missing information on several UIs
[*] NOTE: Controller implementation is still work in progress. Some have no button prompts, bugs and more. Your feedback is much appreciated.
[/list] 

That’s all for this update, Principals! We are getting closer to the official release of the game, and all of us from the VAHSS2 team want to say thank you very much for your support! 

See you on the next update, Principals!

notes.title: Update [7]//Patch 0.8.0.0 and Console Announcement
notes.content:
Hi Principals! We are back with another exciting update for you. 

[h1]Latest Update Ver 0.8.0.0[/h1]

Things are getting a little hotter in Valthiria—all thanks to a recently discovered Hidden Dungeon. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/c4d7e98ad4e57b2b80787609ac506675e40b5c46.png[/img]

With glassy obsidian, rough pumice, and molten lava all around, this hidden dungeon might be too hot to handle, except for the future heroes from the Academy. Just remind your students: “don’t play with fire”! 

With the discovery of the fiery dungeon, it became clearer that Valthiria is not entirely free of danger. Monsters show up now and then, deterring the residents of Valthiria from solo travel. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/7da9ffad785a0ff48b267284ed4beab3283f81b5.png[/img]

To help ease the residents of Valthiria, the Academy offers a solution: Escort Mission! With students as bodyguard-slash-companion, travelers could be safe from various monsters that lurks in the forest. And maybe from a loneliness, too. No judgement. 

Be careful though, as every traveler will take a space on your team. Some might be able to help in fight, while some can’t. It’s part of the mission: fighting with less attack power and more possible casualties! Can your students handle the challenge? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/7845c615b734fc2107411379f175452f2bc31622.png[/img]

At least it would be a great networking event! 

This update includes: 

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New quest type: Escort 
[*] Revamped world map UI 
[*] Revamped exploration UI 
[*] Skip button on dialogues and cinematics 
[/list]
 
[h2]Contents[/h2]
[list]
[*] New dungeon: Lava Fields 
[*] New monsters on Lava Fields 
[*] New student skills 
[*] Removed tutorial tasks that are no longer relevant 
[*] Polished the dungeons to make them more immersive 
[*] Quest reward adjustments 
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized some in-game assets 
[*] Set the default teleport gate back to academy 
[*] Fixed story timeline and quest requirements 
[*] Fixed the Sort by Name feature 
[*] Minor revisions to tutorial and help menu 
[*] Smashed some more bugs 
[/list]

Furthermore, we have more exciting news!

[h1]Early Access and Console Release Announcement[/h1]

Good news, everyone!

Valthirian Arc: Hero School Story 2 will be out of early access and coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch in Early 2023! The physical edition for Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5 will also be available on release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/715d795d637c698a7028d537cb5491f2147cd8ab.png[/img]


Also watch our new trailer below

[previewyoutube=79W8FYZG3pc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update [6]//Patch 0.7.0.0
notes.content:
Greetings, Principals, and...Lady Principals!

One of the most-awaited updates, we’re excited to announce that the female principal is finally ready to join the Academy! We recognize that having this choice is an important thing for our players, so we hope this option will enhance your playing experience even more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/c36efcf3760e68c6c6eb8d64799c89181e2f49af.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/8b56600493b34a944ade5274319430c731a7fcd5.png[/img]

Ever heard about “strike the first blow”? Now in battle, delivering the first strike will give you an advantage! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/ce15592c27061479fac559de4e2d572ff5890910.png[/img]

Every time you manage to strike an enemy first, another student in the party will immediately dish out a second attack, giving you a notable head start in the battle. You can maximize this advantage by finding the right formation for your party. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/b09a2bb08909512a53073ed11c989e2de5cccd4a.png[/img]

And last buat not least: the principal isn’t the only new character in this update. We also added two new champions. Meet: Tiana Cherenkov and Chad Donnervogel!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/031786126cf7ae6f172091b2376d0176f67a68ff.png[/img]

They have different outlooks on life, and they are eager to prove each other wrong. If you see them around the Academy, they’re most likely competing in something. Something that you didn’t even know could be a competition. At least it’s free entertainment, right?

One student said that Tiana and Chad have hundreds of these minor competitions, and their total wins are almost always at a draw. Another student says that even the teachers are split on who will be the winner in the end. Catch their friendly (or not?) rivalry on the upcoming update!

[h3]This update includes:[/h3]
•	New feature: Female Principal
•	New feature: Pre-emptive attacks
•	Added in-game Achievements
•	Major UI overhaul
•	Added sorting feature on several UIs
•	Improved skill visuals
•	New characters: Chad & Tiana
•	More quests, tasks, and events
•	Balanced Champion skills and enemy difficulty
•	Added student spawn animation
•	Fixed a fatal error when pressing [ESC] after choosing a student in battle
•	Fixed graduation and enrollment that keep popping up when cutscenes are in play

[h3]Known Issue:[/h3]
If your monitor is not capable of 2560 x 1440 resolution, please do not set your resolution to 2560 x 1440 in the game settings, as doing so will result in a bug where your cursor movement will be limited.
If the bug does occur, press Alt + Enter to enter windowed mode, then change the resolution via the game settings to a resolution supported by your monitor.

[h3]Follow us social media:[/h3]

Facebook: https://facebook.com/valthirianarc
Discord: https://s.agate.id/vahss2discordlink

notes.title: Update [5]//Patch 0.6.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/99ce7086b2c453074c7e4ed4b07ee5c735292bb7.png[/img]

Hiya Principals! We have another update today, and you can bet that this one is going to make your day! 

Winter has arrived in Valthiria, and the queendom is overjoyed! It's usually a time for hot drinks, staying indoors, and bundling up—but of course, you can’t just laze around in the Academy.  

Behold: the Snowman Building minigame! In this new minigame, the leisure activity of making snowmen is turned into yet another learning opportunity—designed to train champions to notice and remember things quickly. Or at least someone said so. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/97e28d4309d41b7e880db195fdb47430132932c0.png[/img]

It might be useful in a fight, yeah? Maybe? We don’t know, you’re the principal!  

Get your students ready for fresh snow, frozen fingers, and another reason for fun, um, learn—in the Academy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/07aa2271b903a08d6133c416f4b9b6d607201f9e.png[/img]

You can learn from anywhere, but the fancier the place, the better!  

That’s why in this update, we also added a “bulding upgrade” feature for the facilities of the Academy! With the bulding upgrade, you can improve the stats of existing building. The upgraded building will then boost your students’ learning progress. Neat! Afterall, they paid a pretty penny to learn in pretty buildings, right? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/6cb2c91438751003968e2d7ef1dac468c81eb1d4.png[/img]

Principals, meet your new champions: Rena Tarrant and Alphonse Meyer!  

The two new champions couldn’t be more different if they tried. One thing they have in common? Being pushed to learn in the Academy!  

Rena was too lax—and her loving parents wanted her to learn about adulting and responsibility. Alphonse tragic past made him abandon magic—and he’s being dragged to the Academy to rediscover his love for magic... and himself! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/986bb56a3792c1642518ad8f66a508bfdea01672.png[/img]

Will they be able to become a true hero? Their future is in your hands, Principal! 

Here are the complete list of changes and additions in the 0.6.0.0 update: 

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented Building Upgrades
[*] Added Mini game: Snowman Building for Winter Festival 
[*] Revamped Minigame UI
[*] Improved patrolling enemies
[/list]

[h2]Contents[/h2]
[list]
[*] New champions: Alphonse and Rena 
[*] New quests, monsters, and events
[*] New cutscenes
[*] Added missing 2D assets
[*] Rebalanced skills, status effect, etc 
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed timeline for story events
[*] Fixed teleport gate in tundra
[*] Fixed Minigame reward screen getting stuck when choosing reward
[*] Fixed Drink icon in Eating Minigame
[*] Fixed FPS issue in Swimming Minigame 
[*] Fixed several quests and principal task objectives that couldn’t be completed
[/list]

That’s all for this update, Principals! The development of Valthiria will continue, and so is the education standard for the Academy. What’s in the next update? Free lunches? Student loan forgiveness? Stay tuned to find out! 

Meanwhile, watch the trailer for the new champions here: [previewyoutube=RCdwllDiMX8;full][/previewyoutube]

See you on the next update, Principals!

notes.title: Update [4]//Patch 0.5.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/46cc3c7bba7ba4f02a76c13b27e91b3d64abffc1.png[/img]

Hiya Principals, another update is coming today, and you can bet that this one is going to make your day even better! 

In this update, we’ve added a new minigame: the Autumn Feast! As the name suggests, this is an eating contest that you can partake in with students, mentors, and other NPCs in the game.  

Just like a real-life eating contest, this minigame will be a combination of (tummy) management, timing, and perseverance. How’s your appetite lately? Because this huge feast is coming to an Academy near you 🥘 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/c107cff0377e4403061a4faea2dcc726a35d298b.png[/img]

You’ve finished all the quests and cleared the dungeons from monsters. Surely, everything would be fine and dandy, right?  

Wrong! There are always going to be people in need that could use a helping hand, and it’s up to you and your students to save the day! 

Enter a new quest type: Rescue Quests! From this type of quests, your Academy will periodically receive a call for help from beloved residents of Valthiria.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/c1806827bfc70529d6217d1ff041a5a8580dd728.png[/img]
[i]Example of Rescue Quest[/i]

By finishing these Rescue Quests, your students will be, well, not quite “heroes of legends”, but everyday heroes! We all have to start somewhere, right?  

Your Academy will also gain more reputation as students save townsfolk from vicious beasts, and, um... find a soot-filled pan for a distressed grandma? Or at least, one of the Academy’s graduates did that one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/e9150ac23ce88a25d36f5c7485a13dad83fb68f1.png[/img]

We’ve also implemented an Advanced Studies system in the curriculum, so now, your Academy can surpass the proficiency limit even after you’ve built all the buildings in the Academy grounds. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/21204dad02d7a9712cb55887e6425e3331fcb2b4.png[/img]

Here are the complete list of changes and additions in the 0.5.0.0 update:

[*] New Quest type: Rescue 
[*] Implemented Advanced Studies for the research feature 
[/list]

[h2]Contents [/h2]

[*] New dungeon: Tundra 
[*] New quests 
[*] New decision events 
[/list]
 
[h2]Bugfixes [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed story timeline 
[*] Fixed misplaced VFXs 
[*] Standardized some terms for student stats 
[*] Fixed several visual novels and tasks issues 
[*] Smashed other bugs of various sizes
[/list]

Last but not least... two new champions are enrolling in the Academy! You might find one of them reading a book in the corner, minding her own business, while the other one walks around the Academy helping fellow students in need. 
 
You can also explore the new Tundra dungeon/biome (dungeome, anyone?). Grab your warmest, fluffiest coat, and start adventuring!

[previewyoutube=SYxoBBu4MLo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/e3da8d0f96df49e71dd2fb70730f34597c6fe7aa.png[/img]

Principals rejoice, because the 0.4.0.0 update is coming today! Another day, another step towards progress, right?  

This time, we are adding a major feature, and expand on an existing one. Both of them will flesh out the world even further and add new things to do (and consider) when you’re out there managing your academy. 

First thing first, we have added the final part to the political feature: the faction relations system! You might know that managing a relationship is hard, but managing relationships with factions that has different ideology and goals? Hoo boy, now that’s even trickier.  

Fret not though, this is a fun new system that will add [b]a new layer and intricacy to how diplomacy works in the game[/b]. Based on your academy’s standing with a particular faction, you might get bonuses and penalties that will change the way you play – so plan out your move from the get-go! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/c7a6b91a4fedce33237d763b8ec00dde78f86eb5.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Diary #16: Exploration System Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Principals!

It’s been quite a while, isn’t it? To tell you the truth, we’ve been hard at work improving all aspects of the game, one of them being the major change to our exploration system. We moved away from automatic exploration in our previous build to a more open one where you can freely explore the different areas in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/6ff1770ae3e2e611f2b2466222bc250f2a121ff4.png[/img]

At present, there are 3 different areas in the world that you can explore in the early access with 3 more coming along the way  . These areas can be accessed through the world map, representing the varying biomes in the realm of Valthiria itself. Separated based on the combat difficulty, the explorable areas are:

1.	Plains – Difficulty: Easy
2.	Forest – Difficulty: Medium
3.	Mountain – Difficulty: Medium
4.	Desert – Difficulty: Hard (1st update)
5.	Tundra – Difficulty: Hard (2nd update)  
6.	Secret Area (3rd and final update)

Aside from giving players a more pronounced sense of agency, the change also brings about a slew of new features to improve the sense of progression in the exploration itself.

The first is the introduction of the Teleport Gate. In order to start exploring an area, you have to activate a dormant gate. After you activate it, you can fast travel directly to any gate you have activated  . Here’s a neat feature: If you (or your students) are itching to go home, you can directly teleport to the gate located in the academy as well!

Don’t rely on the Teleport Gate to take you away every time you’re in a bind though. There will be certain times when the gate won’t be active, such as when you’re being overrun by a gauntlet of monsters during a quest, or when you need to find an item in an area before you can proceed to the next one.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/ea1aab71ddf9f68e3d1c3a596b818dffcb3f830c.jpg[/img]

It’s not going to be very fun exploring large areas without a place to fall back to and rest, right? We’ve also added the campsite feature in our current build, where your students can lay down, relax, and enjoy the night sky from the comfort of their camp.

Your students may also choose to fully restore their HP at the camp, but there’s a caveat: the monsters they’ve defeated will respawn as well, so choose wisely when to rest and when to keep on adventuring!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/6ae907e74b7961bb29ae24d4a7f6c0fb02d85045.png[/img]

We also know that you might have a little too much fun exploring to only stumble on areas where your students are underleveled. You don’t want to lose your dear students in an “accident,” wouldn’t you? That is why we also put blockades towards certain areas of the game. 

The blockade exists for a variety of reasons, but we ultimately put it so that you will have a far more focused experience while playing the game. This is how the blockade looks like in our current build, but we are working to make it blend more seamlessly to the areas that you are currently exploring:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/924677c4a3d6ab5b1695809ce97ee43c6640a809.jpg[/img]

Well, that’s it for the update on the exploration mode! We’re looking forward to seeing you explore the different biomes that are populated with dangerous (and sometimes cute) monsters that we have lovingly crafted. Stay tuned for more information, we’ll see you on the next Dev Diary! 

---------------
Follow us on our social media:
Twitter: @valthirianarc
Tiktok: @valthirianarc
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/valthirianarc

notes.title: Dev Diary #9: 5th Playtest Recap
notes.content:
Greetings, Principals!
Another playtest result has come in and today we’ll be showing you a recap of the feedback we received. A big thank you to all 75 testers who tried out our 5th alpha build. Your feedback is always appreciated and is crucial to the game’s development. Now let’s jump into the results.

1.	Time Allocation
As stated in our previous playtest recap, we hope to have a more balanced gameplay in VAHHS2. Our time allocation goal is a score of 5 to 6.5, which means testers have a balanced experience both in academy management and combat. In the 4th playtest testers rated the time allocation a 6.7, the current build has a score of 6.6 which still aligns well with our goal and we hope to maintain this score until release.

2.	Comparison with VA:HSS
About 30% of our 5th alpha play testers have played the first VA:HSS game. Out of that 30% about half preferred the previous hack and slash combat system compared to the current turn-based combat. However, the majority commends the game’s new academy management system, let it be the enrolling and graduation aspect or scheduling and courses. The story is also a noteworthy increase from the previous game.

3.	Changes from Previous Build	
We’ve implemented most academy management features in the 4th alpha. However, in the 5th alpha we also added some new features such as the student promotion system and principal task. The principal task as stated before, are goals and task for principals to complete and can help players accustom to the academy. Letting them fully experience all it has to offer. More than 70% of our testers found the principal task helpful and easy to understand, giving it a score of 7.15.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/98c141e753c7010c0bec49ad263a0f6d0001f3d0.png[/img]

Of course, we’re still further polishing the game so there are a few principal task bugs and issues here and there, but hopefully we’ll be able to get rid of those as the game gets closer upon release. One thing to note, we’ll probably add more principal task or clarification regarding student promotions. This is due to the fact that most testers quickly get the hand of scheduling and courses, however some testers completely missed the promotion feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/0649bde049f4ff0a2bdf10f0d41e36a1b67cb4ff.png[/img]

Another thing we plan to work on is the combat tutorial. The combat introduction was changed for the 5th playtest; however, this was met with mixed opinions as some felt the combat was clearer in the 4th alpha. A combat tutorial is currently planned in the works, so hopefully that will help players understand the overall gameplay. 

Buildings have also been improved, facilities are resized and have more varied models, the building upgrade layout have been modified as well, giving it a cleaner look. Building mood effects have also been updated to work properly with adjusted stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/7772dd99704f947c95e96a95afd30fa83aacb965.png[/img]

4.	UI/UX Update
One of the major updates in this build though is the UI. We added new nameplates for the students, new icons, updated the notification feature, implemented in-game menu on quests, updated skill descriptions, and many more. Notification being one of the major updated ones, with added notification for students kicked out of their classes and we also added a student list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/08ebabf551b293005c64d5bf04dc3b628fb30296.png[/img]

The UI design gets a makeover as well, as you can see from the comparison above between the 4th and 5th alpha test. We made significant layout and background changes in the students tab. Courses description are updated, and the student stats are more organized. We’ll probably improve on the visual aesthetic of the UI next, also adding descriptions for some buttons as the game development progress. Recurring testers seem to appreciate the overall improved clarity, so that’s great news!

5.	Combat
Testers who have played the prequel have mixed feelings about the new combat system, some like it, some still preferred the hack and slash system from the first game. This is expected, as turn-based combat is not for everyone. However, testers appreciated the combat length not being too long or short, hitting that sweet spot. Quest time and exploration are considered a bit shorter than expected, but still well received. Skill execution and defense break are still the most favorable aspects of combat. However, we do realize we might need to add more skill chains, gimmicks, and of course, balancing the overall combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/79f6a93d98f14235cc5846354b4cfad56a21b079.png[/img]

6.	Control
We improved the camera control making it more fluid and reactive, but we still want to improve on our camera speed and maybe add some camera invert options. Our feedback results also show that most of our testers use both keyboard and mouse control, although some messaged us that they actually prefer to use the controller. Something we were quite fascinated by and wonder about our audience. Are you a keyboard and mouse fan or more of a controller gamer? Let us know in the comments!

Overall progress is still going as planned. Some features were met less enthusiastically than we hoped, but nothing too far out of our expectations. We’re very glad that some returning players still like the game’s combat, despite the major change from the prequel. We’re also very appreciative of all the feedback we received, many of you made excellent suggestions and we hope we can implement some of them before release. If you have your own opinions and input for VA:HSS2 please feel free to tell us in the comments, or through our social media. 

That’s all for the 5th alpha playtest recap, don’t forget to wishlist us and we’ll see you in the next one, Principals!

notes.title: Dev Diary #5: 4th Playtest Recap
notes.content:
Greetings, Principals!

We’d like to do something a bit different today and show you our previous playtest results. Over 70 principals have joined the 4th Alpha test, and their opinions have greatly helped us further improve VAHSS2’s development. Here’s a recap of their input and our modifications so far:

1.	More Balanced Gameplay

One of our goals in VAHHS2 is to have a more balanced and academy-oriented gameplay compared to the previous game’s more combat heavy one. Out of our scoring system of 1, signifying combat-oriented gameplay, and 10, a more academy-oriented gameplay, testers rated the current build a 6.76. This aligns with our scoring goal of 5 to 6.5, and is a large improvement compared to the 3rd playtest that had a more combat-oriented score of 2.71.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/b932ceb6763794a93d1de6dc9fd580c92fa8bc27.png[/img]

2.	Academy Features Update

On our 4th alpha we wanted to test out more on the academy side, such as assigning the students schedules and courses to help them grow, a promotion system to promote your students, and the building upgrade feature to improve your academy. 

Some of these features have been showcased in the first and second alpha build but were incomplete or not functioning as we’d hope. In the 4th alpha we managed to fully implement all the academy gameplay features along with updating its UI.

Overall, the academy features were met with favorable reviews. Many testers stated it rounds up the system from the previous game and gives a more realistic and polished gameplay. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/d42bd562335f30a2893009b70ad153ef2c9d4d22.png[/img]

3.	Combat System Refinement

Testers favor the combat’s shield break feature, a feature that we’ve discussed in our previous dev diary. Many complimented that matching the student’s proficiency with the shield breaks adds an extra challenge to the game. However, the overall combat score still only has an average of 7, needing further balancing. We’ve also been improving the combat’s visuals effects, polished out some battle transitions, added indicators to better communicate enemy stats, and balance out the battle pacing.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/9a77573480594dce287094c4dc3cfed67adfb7bf.png[/img]

4.	Academy Layout Improvements

Along with the 4th alpha build, came a new layout. In previous builds our academy felt rather empty and scattered. Larger isn’t always better, so we reworked the academy size and building placements around for a more compact look. There are some drawbacks to this approach, mainly less natural environmental elements such as lakes, trees, and waterfalls. Instead, we compensate by providing more space for player decorations and customization. Thankfully, testers appreciated the change, complimenting the academy’s more fitting décor and the overall compact layout.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/74ebd7490ad9407d9c1cf52caac1bcab74b39919.png[/img]

5.	Visual Improvements

As the game progress we continue to improve on its overall appearance. Adding more 2d illustrations, 3d models, effects, and visual novel aspects to the game, making the game livelier and more visually appealing for our testers. Here’s a sneak peek of our updates below! Do note that we will continue to refine the game visuals, and what you see currently might be changed in the final product.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/7ece86a52fc0a8a739271953de3f3d7972ce2f1a.png[/img]

6.	UI/UX Update

More than 60% of testers admire the UI’s visual appeal, but some were still confused with the UI’s clarity. As a result, we’ve modified the UI for better readability, and provided more informative displays such as building lists and student information. We also managed to fix most of the previous build’s UI bugs and hope our efforts show good results in the 5th Alpha test. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/1728f94d20e1fa34fae7ee24b8bf4f8c89655022.png[/img]

Overall, playtesting has gone quite smoothly and it’s all thanks to all you early principals who joined our playtests! We owe it to you guys for noticing our shortcomings and giving us your input to make VAHSS2 the best it can be!

If you’re interested in becoming a play tester for the 5th alpha build, come register here: https://bit.ly/alphateststeam. Your input is very valuable to us and is always appreciated. Well, that’s all from us for now. 

Don’t forget to wishlist and hope to see you in the next post, Principals!

notes.title: Dev Diary #2: Elements of Battle
notes.content:
Welcome back to our Dev Diary series, Principal!

This time we would like to specifically talk about our newest battle system called Shield Break mentioned in our previous dev diary. Explaining in detail about how Shield Break would work for our students in combat.

To start it off, we must introduce a new feature in HSS2 called “Proficiency”. Proficiencies are used in two ways. On enemies, it is presented in a sequence that determines their “Shield”. On students, it is a property of their current class. In simple terms, it’s akin to a ”weapon type” that can “Break” the enemies’ Shield of the same type. 

There are 4 different proficiencies that principals have to pay attention to. (See pic below)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/6506fcfac6e7d94f99c0c68d8620b3952549f0b2.png[/img]
 
Breaking enemies shield gives various tide-turning benefits, such as the ability to deal massive damage or resetting their attack cooldown. All student classes have Proficiency, even low-level ones, so that when Principals bring them along into combat they can serve a function instead of just being a burden. With this Shield Break system, we’re hoping to see Principals utilize a wide range of student rosters in battle for different circumstances instead of having a “favorite team” to fall back into every time. 

To further explain the Shield Break system, let’s use this next picture as an example: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306402/771efec95faaa3efb8a951e3e7e57d1d107244d4.png[/img] 

The enemies in the picture have a different set of proficiencies that our students have to break in order to deal extra damage:
[list]
[*] Enemy A has a Shield with MM sequence 
[*] Enemy B has a Shield with PPD sequence
[/list]
In order for the students to benefit from Shield Break, Enemy A has to be attacked in the correct sequence:
[list]
[*] Two hits from a Magic-proficiency student
[/list]
And Enemy B has to be attacked in this exact sequence:
[list]
[*]  Two hits from a Physical-proficiency student
[*]  One hit from a Divine-proficiency student
[/list]
After breaking the Shield, the enemy will have sign that shows “Shield Break”. Any students that deal damage will benefit from it no matter the Proficiency they have. 

Despite its importance, Shield Breaking is not mandatory. Even when an enemy’s Shield isn’t broken, students will still be able to deal damage, albeit at a reduced rate. So if you don’t bring the optimal roster into battle, or don’t have the right students in your academy, you’ll still be able to get through combat with a some more effort.

With this new information explained, we hope that principals would get the idea and be as excited as us while developing this new system! 

We now will wrap up the diary Number 2 that explains how Shield Break works and we will see you in our next diary. Thank you for your time reading!
